newsitem.title: USA: Pennzoil to launch new ad campaign.
newsitem.headline: Pennzoil to launch new ad campaign.

text.p: Pennzoil Products Co said Wednesday it was launching an advertising campaign that breaks with the usual way it has promoted its motor oil in the past.
The company said the campaign, which will include print, radio and television, will emphasize how the oil works for drivers every day rather than its actual physical properties.
Pennzoil said it wants to change the way people think about its product by focusing on stop-and-go driving with the line, "Stop. Go. Pennzoil".
The campaign, which was developed with the company's new advertizing firm GSD&M, will also try to make the product appealing to women, Hispanics and new drivers, it said.
Pennzoil Products Co is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Pennzoil Co.
